description: This Java source file defines a class `QuickSharingPermissionsBottomSheetDialog` which represents a bottom sheet dialog for quick sharing permissions management in an Android application. It provides UI components and logic to display and modify sharing permissions related to `OCShare` objects, supporting different permission options based on whether the share is for a folder or a file.

classes.name: QuickSharingPermissionsBottomSheetDialog
classes.description: A bottom sheet dialog class that facilitates the display and modification of sharing permissions for an OCShare object, with UI setup, permission handling, and branding adaptation.

methods.name: QuickSharingPermissionsBottomSheetDialog
methods.description: Constructor initializing the bottom sheet dialog with activity context, actions handler, and OCShare object.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog's UI, sets layout parameters, and calls setup for RecyclerView.

methods.name: setUpRecyclerView
methods.description: Prepares and attaches the RecyclerView with permission options for user interaction.

methods.name: handlePermissionChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in permission selection, invoking actions and dismissing the dialog appropriately.

methods.name: getQuickPermissionList
methods.description: Generates the list of Permission models for display based on OCShare and app resources.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cleans up references when the dialog is stopped to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies a branding theme or color scheme to the dialog and its components.
